sources.note: kaikki.org states the extract comes from the enwiktionary dump dated 2026-09-02 and is updated at least weekly. sha256 and fetchedAt are written by the build itself (--update-sources) and are the guard for a rebuild: a source whose bytes changed is a new pack, never a silently different one.
